sections.text: Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I2, which 
must be carried out on an annually bases
as indicated in the above title block by Y1. 
The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 2/8/02 for El-Matar circuit no. 2 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, 
Cairo zone.

Safety 
Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance st off should
 carry the suitable
safety category.
Safety rope with caution marks surrounding the work area must be used
Wear your safety helmet and safety harnesses

Switch on the earthing switch and check mechanical interlocking with the 
 disconnect switch
Isolation and proper earthing is required.
Switch off the DC source

sections.text: Environmental Precautions
Tools and Equipments

items:
Safety helmet, 
 grease, suitable tool set

Pieces of 
 cloths and rags
Cleaning liquid (like gasoline)

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Clean porcelain surface from dust, dirties, or any deposits 
....... etc.

Inspect well the insulators and check if
there is unseen crack, current traces, or alike

Remove the old grease out of the blades
and contacts of disconnect switch and clean them with gasoline then put a new
thin film of grease

Tighten bolts and nuts of disconnect
switch

Inspect the mechanical interlocking
between the earthing switch and disconnect switch
Clean the gear box and then grease it

Check disconnect switch motor - drives,
clean it.

Clean the blade of earthing
switch (that engages with disconnect switch)

Check the earthing
switch motor, clean and grease the gear box

Clean the blade of the earthing switch and
softly grease it

Inspect the marshalling box of the disconnect switch, remove dust, then
clean auxiliary switch limit switch, push buttons, etc ... witch video cleaner

Inspect the gasket of marshalling box and check if the box is closed
tightly to prevent dust from going into the box
Grease the horizontal axis of Disconnect switch
Inspect the operating arms and its hinges, and grease the hinges

Inspect the marshalling box of the earthing
switch, remove dust, then clean auxiliary switch, limit switch, push buttons,
etc... with video cleaner
